surface_mechanism_description: The growth mechanism involves adsorption, desorption, and decomposition of TMGa molecules on the surface. TMGa molecules adsorb on the arsenic monolayer with a time constant τad and desorb with a time constant τds. The adsorbed TMGa molecule can either desorb from the surface or decompose with a time constant τde. Once a TMGa molecule decomposes on the surface, another TMGa can readily adsorb at the nearest adsorption site.
evidence: The surface density of adsorbed TMGa, nTMGa, and that of thermally decomposed Ga, nGa, are expressed by the rate equations dnTMGa/dt = - (1 - nTMGa - nGa) - (1/τad + 1/τdc) nTMGa and dnGa/dt = -nTMGa / τde. The adsorbed TMGa quickly desorbs even from arsenic atoms around 500 °C. The decomposition time constant τdc is the fitting parameter for the temperature dependence of the growth rate.
